bbd.text: Arcades's colony is a walled human settlement where, in a flashback in the Battlebond story, the twins find their sibling Arcades Sabboth living inside the great ring wall. When humans shoot at the twins, Nicol burns a tower and soldiers, and Arcades slams into him, but Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas and the twins are admitted to the colony as Arcades's guests.

The twins live for years in the colony, where Ugin befriends the holy elder Te Ju Ki, who shows him globes of light she calls planes and teaches that death is part of endless cycles. After years of peace one man stabs his brother in a sudden quarrel, and Nicol watches with satisfaction.
Nicol tells Ugin he has found a better way to avenge their sister and flies off without farewells, and Arcades dismisses Ugin's concerns, so Ugin leaves Te Ju Ki to follow Nicol.
